title: Dealer Lead Routing and Follow-Up Automation
summary: Pull leads from OEM portals, websites, classifieds, social forms and walk-ins into one hub, remove duplicates, route them to the right consultant and run approved WhatsApp follow-ups.

seo.title: Dealer Lead Routing and Follow-Up Automation | VipraTech
seo.description: Lead automation for car and two-wheeler dealers: deduplicate leads from every source, route by location and model, track SLAs, follow up on WhatsApp.

designed_for: Dealer Principal or Dealer Group CEO

problem.intro: A dealer group receives leads from the OEM lead portal, its own websites, car classifieds, social media forms, call-ins, walk-in registers and its own service customers. The same buyer often appears in several places, some leads never get an owner, and the OEM asks for status updates the dealer struggles to provide.

pain_points.title: Duplicate and orphan leads
pain_points.detail: The same buyer arrives from several sources while other leads sit unassigned in a portal nobody checks daily.

pain_points.title: Routing by guesswork
pain_points.detail: Leads go to whoever is free, not by showroom location, model expertise or the buyer's language.

pain_points.title: Follow-ups depend on memory
pain_points.detail: Consultants juggle many prospects, and follow-up cadences break down in busy months.

pain_points.title: Status gaps with the OEM
pain_points.detail: Lead outcomes and lost reasons rarely flow back to the OEM portal, which hurts dealer scorecards and makes campaign spend hard to judge.

solution.overview: We build a lead hub that connects every source your group uses. Incoming leads are normalised, matched against existing records to remove duplicates and enriched with model, location and source. Routing rules set by your sales managers assign each lead by pincode, brand, model, language and consultant workload, and an SLA timer escalates leads that have not been contacted. A language model drafts personalised WhatsApp follow-ups from approved templates and price sheets, and consultants approve any message that mentions price, offers or finance. Outcomes and lost reasons sync back to the DMS and the OEM lead portal, and dashboards show the funnel by source and showroom.
capabilities: Ingests and deduplicates leads from the OEM portal, websites, classifieds, social forms and walk-in registers
Routes by pincode, brand, model, language and consultant workload
SLA timers with escalation to team leads for uncontacted leads
Personalised WhatsApp follow-ups drafted from approved templates and price sheets
Intent scoring from source, engagement and conversation notes
Syncs lead status and lost reasons back to the DMS and OEM lead systems

workflow.title: Capture leads
workflow.detail: Leads arrive from every connected source into one hub.

workflow.title: Deduplicate and enrich
workflow.detail: Records are matched to existing customers and leads, and ambiguous matches are queued for a person to confirm.

workflow.title: Score and route
workflow.detail: Rules assign each lead to a showroom and consultant, with an intent score.

workflow.title: Watch the SLA
workflow.detail: Leads not contacted within the agreed time escalate to the team lead for reassignment.

workflow.title: Follow up
workflow.detail: Cadenced WhatsApp messages and call tasks run, with consultants approving any price or offer content.

workflow.title: Sync and analyse
workflow.detail: Status and lost reasons flow to the DMS and OEM portal and feed funnel and source reports.

inputs: Leads from the OEM portal, websites, classifieds and social forms
Service customers flagged for exchange or upgrade
Consultant roster, showrooms and pincode coverage
Approved message templates and price sheets
outputs: Deduplicated, scored lead records with owners
Status and lost reasons synced to the DMS and OEM portal
Funnel reports by source, showroom and consultant
human_in_the_loop: Consultants approve every message that mentions price, offers or finance, and team leads handle SLA escalations. Sales managers own the routing rules, and ambiguous duplicate matches are confirmed by a person before records merge.
guardrails: Messages use approved templates and price sheets only
Opt-outs honoured across every channel immediately
No false urgency or pressure messaging
Ambiguous duplicates confirmed by a person, never merged blindly
Consultant approval for price, offer and finance content
compliance_notes: Messaging follows TRAI commercial communication rules and WhatsApp opt-in requirements.
Lead and customer data handled under the DPDP Act 2023, including consent and retention limits.

pilot.scope: One dealer group, two showrooms and one brand, connecting the OEM portal, the website and one classifieds source.
deliverables: Routing rules configured with sales managers

what_we_measure.how: Time from lead creation to first call or message, by source.
Counts before and during the pilot.
Share of leads receiving the agreed cadence.
Tracked by source and showroom across the pilot period.

faqs.q: Will it work with our OEM's DMS and lead portal?
faqs.a: We integrate through whatever the OEM allows: APIs, scheduled exports or controlled automation of portal updates. The DMS stays the system of record, and we confirm the route with your OEM contact early.

faqs.q: We sell several brands. Can routing handle that?
faqs.a: Yes. Routing rules can separate brands, showrooms and consultant teams, and the same buyer enquiring about two brands is flagged rather than merged.

faqs.q: Is there a risk of our WhatsApp number being blocked?
faqs.a: We send only to opted-in contacts, use approved templates, respect frequency limits and honour opt-outs instantly, which keeps the account in good standing.
Consultants see their leads, drafts and tasks on mobile, and approval takes a tap. We involve a few consultants in the pilot design so the flow fits how they already work.
